clause: StudioLiveFilter live-filter-layer mechanism + smart-filter attachment + per-filter masking [STU-RAS-037]

scope.summary: Implement ONLY the 14.4-owned live-filter mechanism (the concrete filter catalog is 14.9): the non-destructive live_filter-kind layer hosting one StudioLiveFilter applied to layers below or clipped to its parent; smart-filter attachment to a placed_asset container; per-filter masking; and the rule that any 14.9 filter runnable non-destructively MUST be available as a StudioLiveFilter, with a destructive apply-to-pixels form (via MT-024) also existing for each. Do not enumerate the 14.9 catalog here.
proof_targets: live-filter re-edit + smart-filter re-render runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: attach a live_filter layer, edit its parameters non-destructively, mask part of it, then apply-to-pixels and confirm a distinct history entry
live: attach a smart filter to a placed_asset and confirm it re-renders on source change
test: a 14.9 non-destructive filter is exposed as a StudioLiveFilter
acceptance_criteria_original: live_filter layer + smart-filter attachment + per-filter masking work
re-editable non-destructive + destructive apply-to-pixels form; consumes 14.9 catalog

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Live filters & smart filters

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-037]** `StudioLiveFilter` is the single canonical live-filter primitive: a re-editable, maskable filter hosted on a `live_filter`-kind layer or applied to a `placed_asset` container. The concrete live-filter catalog is enumerated once in 14.9; 14.4 owns only the non-destructive live-filter-layer mechanism, the attachment to placed-asset containers, per-filter masking, and the rule that any 14.9 filter that can run non-destructively MUST be available as a `StudioLiveFilter` with a destructive apply-to-pixels form as well.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
